name: Power Pickers
description: Pickers for the two things that are always a plain text box: icons and colours. Six custom fields — four icon libraries, plus a hex colour picker and a named colour picker.

configValues.name: brandSwatches
configValues.label: Brand swatches
configValues.description: Quick-pick swatches shown in both colour fields. Comma or newline separated, as '#0F62FE' or 'Brand Blue #0F62FE'. Leave blank for none.

configValues.name: hexAllowAlpha
configValues.label: Allow transparency in the Hex Colour field
configValues.description: Set to 'true' to add an opacity slider. Values stay #RRGGBB while fully opaque and become #RRGGBBAA once they are not. Defaults to off, because 8-digit hex is not safe everywhere.

configValues.name: namedColourSet
configValues.label: Named colour set
configValues.description: Replaces the 148 CSS named colours in the Named Colour field with your own tokens, as 'brand-blue #0F62FE, brand-ink #101828'. Leave blank to use the CSS names.

fields.name: icon-lucide
fields.label: Icon — Lucide
fields.description: Pick a Lucide icon. Stores the icon name, e.g. 'arrow-right'.

fields.name: icon-heroicons
fields.label: Icon — Heroicons
fields.description: Pick a Heroicon in any of its four styles. Stores 'style/name', e.g. 'outline/academic-cap'.

fields.name: icon-fontawesome
fields.label: Icon — Font Awesome
fields.description: Pick a Font Awesome Free icon. Stores 'style/name', e.g. 'solid/star' or 'brands/github'.

fields.name: icon-simple-icons
fields.label: Icon — Simple Icons (brands)
fields.description: Pick a brand logo from Simple Icons. Stores the slug, e.g. 'github'.

fields.name: colour-hex
fields.label: Colour — Hex
fields.description: Pick a colour visually. Stores a hex value, e.g. '#0F62FE'.

fields.name: colour-named
fields.label: Colour — Named
fields.description: Pick from the CSS named colours, or from your own named tokens. Stores the name, e.g. 'rebeccapurple'.
